title: Cross-Multiplication Method — Pair of Linear Equations in Two Variables
hook: Let's explore Cross-Multiplication Method from the chapter on Pair of Linear Equations in Two Variables. This is an important concept in NCERT Class 10 Mathematics that builds your foundation for higher studies!
explanation:
Cross-Multiplication Method A formula-based method for solving a₁x + b₁y + c₁ = 0 and a₂x + b₂y + c₂ = 0 using the cross-multiplication rule. Key Ideas to Master:
💡 x/(b₁c₂ − b₂c₁) = y/(c₁a₂ − c₂a₁) = 1/(a₁b₂ − a₂b₁)
💡 Write equations in standard form: ax + by + c = 0
💡 Works when a₁b₂ − a₂b₁ ≠ 0 (unique solution exists)
💡 Quick way to get both x and y in one step
